supplied_tf48_mgrid_checkpoint.resolution_warning: 36 MGRID planes do not resolve 48-fold coil ripple; use the direct-coil ripple reference or regenerate at adequate phi resolution

field_case: Interpolate the supplied 14 T TF48 MGRID without amplitude rescaling.
mhd_rule: Lorentz force and Joule heating must use the spatial vector field; a uniform 14 T scalar is insufficient.
magnet_self_heating_rule: Coil AC/hysteresis/coupling and resistive heat, if modeled, belong to the magnet cryogenic/thermal ledger and must not be deposited in the liquid-wall laser patches.
